title: Tenma Saki — The Best Doll Festival!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhummhuuum♪
Good morning, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki? You seem to be in a good mood this morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Do I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just looked at the calendar and saw that there's only two weeks left until the Doll Festival♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I haven't been able to really celebrate since I was little, so I'm super excited!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then we'll just have to make up for it all this year!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Then can we have a Doll Festival party and invite the girls too?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's a great idea! I'll help you in any way I can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! I'll tell them about it during band practice!
School SEKAI
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough practice for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Good work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were really great today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. She stayed in rhythm the entire time!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. She even threw in some nice improvisations too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Did something good happen, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe she got a snack with a prize in it or something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Better!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Better...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I have an announcement to make...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The Doll Festival is two weeks from now and I'm having a party to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A Doll Festival party?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! It's been so long since I got to celebrate at home too, which is why I want to do something big. Tsukasa even said he'd help out♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay... You were always sick or in the hospital around this time of year so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm all better now! That's why I want to celebrate and make up for all that time I lost!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then we should start getting ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. We'll help you out too, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, you'll come party with us too, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm guessing you won't stop asking until I say yes so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Duh! I really want you to be there too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... Will you come?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I stay at home, my sister's just gonna make up some excuse about it being a day to celebrate sisterhood and never leave me alone so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hahaha... Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Good for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, I get that you want to make up for lost time, but is the Doll Festival really something you can make this big a deal about...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, that definitely means there's a reason.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our doll stand is huge! I always loved setting it up every year with my family and looked forward to it every year ever since I was little...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But like Ichi said, I was always sick or in the hospital around this time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And there was one year when I felt more depressed than usual too. I think it was back in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Tsukasa, he...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... I take that back!
Let's talk about the party instead!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you leave us hanging like that, it'll just make us want to know more...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right. I think everyone else agrees too, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. But I think Saki wants to save it for later, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, we'll just have her tell us in private later then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then that settles that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, just them?
Can't you just tell us, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope♪ You'll just have to wait until the day of!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that's how you're playing this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If that's the case, Saki... How about THIS...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wah, H-Hona! Nooo! Stop...! That tickles...!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll get her from this side...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Ichi...?! Hahahaha! No, stop...!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you feel like talking now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha! N-Nope...! It wouldn't mean anything unless I tell you while showing you those dolls...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Darn. You're so stubborn...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe Saki's won this round.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll tell you during the party, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then we'll just have to wait.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll be looking forward to your party, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's gonna be so much fun!
